nodes.label: Default Avatar Fallback Image
nodes.description: A humorous, cannabis-themed default avatar image. Shows a green furry monster character (reminiscent of Cookie Monster but green-colored) holding a cookie and smoking a joint/cannabis cigarette, with smoke rising. The image is a high-quality AI-generated or photorealistic render with a teal/dark green background. Used as the fallback avatar for users who have not uploaded a profile picture on the WeedHub platform.
